en.headline: Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to Wan Chai waterfront
en.dek: The three-day event at Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space opens today with large installations and evening live music through Sunday.
body: The Spooky Halloween music carnival returns to the Wan Chai Harbourfront Event Space from today through Sunday, according to the Hong Kong Tourism Board.

Organised by Live Nation Electronic Asia, the event occupies the site at 3 Hung Hing Road. The carnival zone opens at 4pm today and from noon on Saturday and Sunday, closing at 10pm each day. The main stage operates from 6pm to 10.30pm daily.

Installations include a nine-metre-tall figure from Attack on Titan, a Godzilla display and a horror maze presented by CLOT. Inflatable slides, game booths and food stalls are also on site. The Tourism Board described the setup as an immersive festive destination for families, youths and pop-culture fans.
Ticket options and the final performance line-up are listed on the organiser’s channels. The event runs through 1 November.

zh.headline: Spooky Halloween 音樂嘉年華重返灣仔海濱
zh.dek: 為期三日的活動今日起於灣仔海濱活動空間舉行，設有大型裝置及晚間現場音樂，至周日結束。
body: 香港旅遊發展局表示，Spooky Halloween 音樂嘉年華由今日起至周日重返灣仔海濱活動空間。
活動由 Live Nation Electronic Asia 主辦，地點為鴻興道3號。嘉年華區今日下午四時開放，周六及周日則由中午開放，每日至晚上十時結束。主舞台每日下午六時至晚上十時三十分運作。
現場裝置包括九米高的《進擊的巨人》巨型形象、哥斯拉展示及由 CLOT 呈獻的驚悚迷宮。另有充氣滑梯、遊戲攤位及美食攤檔。旅發局形容活動為適合家庭、青年及流行文化愛好者的沉浸式節日目的地。
門票選項及最終演出陣容可於主辦方渠道查閱。活動至十一月一日結束。
